five_fold_grouped_confirmation.interpretation: additional grouped stability confirmation on the development dataset; not an independent external test because feature selection used development OOF evidence

candidate.model: 100-tree ExtraTreesClassifier; depth 22; min leaf 15; sqrt features; balanced_subsample; threshold 0.5

ensemble_and_calibration.decision: No ensemble selected; 50/50 blend was below the standalone candidate. No calibration or new threshold tuning was added; probabilities are uncalibrated.

error_analysis.target_source: verified grouped development OOF only; raw source target column not loaded

feature_ablation.interpretation: Group ablation preserves numeric edit geometry and flags while removing all five learned gate/alignment category fields; compare on exact same grouped folds and threshold.

inference.input_contract: Existing eight raw metadata inputs plus original and mutant OpenQASM 2.0 text; derives position_fraction and 15 QASM features.
inference.single_and_batch_smoke: Passed using an actual development circuit pair; probabilities are uncalibrated.

limitations: 85% aspirational macro-F1 was not reached (79.33% in the additional grouped CV).
The additional five-fold CV reused development rows that informed feature selection; it is a stability confirmation, not an independent test.
No new nested threshold/calibration analysis or inner-fold stacking was run.
Common-prefix/suffix alignment marks large/reordered edits complex and withholds local context.
QASM source text is required at inference, and parsing cost scales with circuit size.
Some origins remain substantially harder; see subgroup sample counts and intervals in the error-analysis JSON.

full_oof_macro_f1_selected_threshold_des.selection_bias_note: same OOF predictions were used to choose and score this threshold; nested fold results are the less-biased assessment

nested_grouped_results.note: Final OOF thresholds are for a future deployment fit only; same-OOF metrics are descriptive and not unbiased performance estimates.
nested_grouped_results.objective: Nested leave-one-development-fold-out threshold selection; each fold threshold fitted only on the other two folds

prior_threshold_study.reason: Nested fold thresholds (0.495, 0.460, 0.480) did not improve mean held-fold macro F1 over using 0.5 directly; the all-OOF selected threshold is optimistic.

selection.decision: Select the mutation-aware Extra Trees as the new versioned development model.
selection.promotion_bar: +0.5 percentage points grouped macro F1, fold support, and no material safeguard degradation.
selection.qualification: The development labels informed feature selection, so neither confirmation is an independent external test. The previously examined historical frozen set was not used.
selection.result: +2.067 points on saved three-fold OOF and +1.993 points on additional five-fold grouped CV; every paired fold improved.

target: WOO/OPO=detected (1); Survivor=not detected (0). This is historical benchmark outcome prediction, not hardware-noise detection or fault localization.
